name: server-group
help: Configure an ICAP server group consisting of multiple forward servers. Supports failover and load balancing.

name.name: name
name.help: Configure an ICAP server group consisting one or multiple forward servers. Supports failover and load balancing.

options.name: weighted
options.help: Load balance traffic to forward servers based on assigned weights.

options.name: least-session
options.help: Send new sessions to the server with lowest session count.

options.name: active-passive
options.help: Send new sessions to active server with high weight.

server-list.name: server-list
server-list.help: Add ICAP servers to a list to form a server group. Optionally assign weights to each server.

weight.name: weight
weight.help: Optionally assign a weight of the forwarding server for weighted load balancing (1 - 100, default = 10).
